ios.desc:
Plan Smarter Drives with Weather Along Your Route

Wayther is a fast, powerful, and easy-to-use app that gives you accurate, hour-by-hour weather forecasts along your route — so you can drive with confidence, no matter where the road takes you.


Avoid Dangerous Conditions. Save Time and Money.
▶ Make informed decisions about when to drive and which route to take
▶ Avoid weather delays and detours that cost time and fuel
▶ Know what to expect in advance — rain, snow, wind, fog, heat, nightfall, and more

No more checking a dozen forecasts for each city or stop — Wayther shows you everything in one place. It calculates the weather at key points along your drive based on your departure or arrival time, helping you plan up to 10 days ahead. Whether you're driving for work, vacation, or adventure, Wayther has your back.


Key Features:
▶ Route Summary and Overview: Quickly identify severe weather alerts, high winds, extreme low/high temperatures, heavy precipitation, poor visibility, and night driving conditions.
▶ Waypoints and Timeline: See a detailed timeline with accurate forecasts on temperature, precipitation, wind, visibility, and sunrise/sunset times.
▶ Interactive Map: View your route and waypoints on an interactive map. Know when and where to stop for optimal driving conditions.
▶ Departures/arrival Time: Determine the best time to drive based on your preferences.
▶ Alternative Routes: Compare alternative routes to find the safest and most comfortable one.
▶ Worldwide Support: Forecasts are provided in all countries where Apple Weather is available. Choose between metric or imperial units.


Wayther is perfect for:
▶ Truckers: Plan long hauls smarter, avoid delays, and protect your cargo
▶ RV and Trailer Drivers: Dodge high winds, icy roads, and steep mountain passes
▶ Motorcyclists: Stay dry and safe by avoiding rain, snow, and low visibility
▶ Commuters & Road Trippers: Know the best time to leave and avoid surprise storms
▶ Bus & Shuttle Drivers: Minimize risk for passengers and stay on schedule


---
Wayther includes limited free usage, allowing you to try its features.
For continued access and an enhanced experience, additional options are available through in-app purchases.

Your subscription directly supports the app's development and maintenance, and helps cover the costs of commercial weather forecasts. Thank you!

quotes.text:
Hey all,

I'm Axel, and I just launched a new iOS app called Wayther. It's a weather forecast app specifically for your road trips, giving you accurate weather forecasts along your route up to 10 days in advance, anywhere in the world. You can pick different routes and adjust your departure or arrival times to find the perfect window for a safe and enjoyable trip.

Download the app on the App Store here: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6449394257

I’d love to hear your thoughts. If you try Wayther and like it, please consider rating it on the App Store—it helps a lot!

--

The backstory:
A while back, I had to drive a few hundred miles and wanted to dodge bad weather (like rain, high winds, poor visibility, extreme temperatures, blinding sun, night drive). I was tired of juggling Apple Maps and Apple Weather, typing in location after location to check the conditions at different points along the route. I thought, "Wouldn’t it be great if there was an app for this?" So, I built one!
Wayther isn’t just for car trips; it’s great for motorcycles, RVs, trucks, buses, and bikes too. It can help you avoid high winds, bad weather, plan the best times to hit the road and reduce your travel costs too!

How it works:
1. Enter your starting point and destination. 
2. Pick a route from up to three options. 
3. Choose your departure or arrival date to fit your schedule and preferences.
